scene: The green slime tingles warm, rippling open three glowing transport portals.
picture: Side-view pixel art along the mall concourse floor. On the far left, a river hover ferry bobs by an open gate. Next stands the bubbling fountain, where the silver-haired boy pulls his dripping hand back. At centre-right waits the glass karaoke lift with open doors, and far right stands an open steel freight elevator.
shown: a sleek river hover ferry floating by a low gate on the far left
a glowing glass karaoke lift waiting with doors parted at centre-right
a heavy steel freight elevator with yellow stripes open on the far right
